name: pcap_summary
description: Read a pcap or pcapng with no external dependency and return the shape of it: link type, snap length, time range, conversations with bytes and packets each way, grouped per session or per endpoint, top talkers, ports and protocols, and the connection start times a beacon check needs.

with_starts.description: Include each conversation's connection start times, for beacon_score

group.description: session (default, one row per TCP session) or endpoint (one row per source, destination and service port, which is what a beacon check needs)
